data.exact_reserve_text: An overall improvement of GBP 3.3 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year. This is due to improvements of GBP 3.6 million on property reinsurance and GBP 0.2 million on marine reinsurance partially offset by a deterioration of GBP 0.5 million on casualty reinsurance.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Significant exposure to BI claims affecting 2019 and 2020 years of account with uncertainty over ultimate liability and reserve adequacy, particularly tied to legal rulings in Australia.

prior_year_events.event_name: CG Restaurants & Bars v RSA (court case)
prior_year_events.impact_description: New court case expected to challenge basis upon which claims have been paid to date and increased uncertainty on 2018 year outcomes (influenced decision to close 2018 with loss of capacity).
Legal development cited alongside CG Restaurants & Bars v RSA as affecting interpretation and payment of certain claims impacting prior years.

named_events.loss_description: Very severe winter storm and freeze, named Uri, hit the US state of Texas causing around US$15bn of insured damage; reported as a notable loss event during 2021.
Largest single loss event of 2021; industry insured loss estimated around US$36bn; described as the largest natural perils loss incurred by the syndicate during 2021.
Extremely damaging flood in central Europe in July causing around US$13bn of insured damage (up to US$40bn economic losses).
Outbreak of tornadoes across the US Midwest in December 2021 noted among the year's events.
Wildfire in Denver occurring 'out of season' in December 2021 noted among loss events.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded an overall favourable prior-year development of GBP 3.3m (a release, approximately 3.1% of opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 106.65m) driven by favourable development on property reinsurance (GBP 3.6m) and marine reinsurance (GBP 0.2m) partially offset by adverse development on casualty reinsurance (GBP 0.5m). Material uncertainty remains from COVID-19 business interruption claims (notably affecting 2019 and 2020 years of account) and recent court cases have added legal risk to prior-year outcomes.
raw_causal_phrases: An overall improvement of GBP 3.3 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding prior-year column). Prior-year movement taken from Note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which explicitly states gross amounts. Page numbers are the printed page headers within the report (claims outstanding on printed page 20; movement and premium segment on printed page 30). Named events are discussed in the Managing Agent's Report (printed page 4) but syndicate-level net losses for those events are not quantified in the report.
